checks.name: All new routes contain a single title and selected navigation
Home covers all historical results and new branches without claiming a prize solution
Every research link in the new pages resolves to a real route or result
Unknown and inherited routes preserve recovery and established pages
Finite-volume plot samples equal their CSV, with physical axes explicit
Spectral and response plots retain every CSV row in matching series
The actual response-grid discrepancies recompute from raw histories
Missing or nonfinite plot records fail explicitly
Search, empty result, type filter and injected labels remain safe
Document dialogs expose the full checked notes through the escaped shared control
All new download links point to existing assets
Scientific status stays scoped and missing symbolic reruns remain blocked
Every source has an explicit scope and an HTTPS primary link

scope: VM route, event, data binding and evidence tests; no browser layout/keyboard testing.
